title: Maiao: Gerrit-style code review workflow for GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, others
summary: Maiao is a CLI tool that brings Gerrit's linear code review workflow to GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and other Git hosting platforms. It enables teams to use the superior commit-based review model popularized by Gerrit while leveraging their preferred Git platform.
problem_solved: Enables Gerrit-style linear code review workflow on platforms that traditionally only support fork-based workflows.
why_valuable: Combines Gerrit's mature, commit-based review process with the flexibility of modern Git hosting platforms, improving code quality for teams.
